decisions.decision: Bill will set up a meeting with the Select Board for Chip Wilson's interview and appointment vote
decisions.quote: bill noted he would set up a short joint meeting with the select board for an interview and a vote to appoint chip.

decisions.decision: Commissioners will discuss the Sewer Connection Charge Policy at the March 10 meeting
decisions.quote: andrew said they could not discuss it as it was not on the agenda but asked the commissioners to let him know if they have any edits. then they will discuss the policy at the meeting on 3/10.

decisions.decision: Commissioners agreed to the Select Board's suggestion of a joint Sewer & Stormwater Commission
decisions.quote: the select board suggested having a joint sewer & stormwater commission and the commissioners agreed.

budget_items.quote: they put in $200k for the capital plan for a few big repairs.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Original revenue estimate of $1.2 million with projected deficit of $200,000 before rate adjustments
budget_items.quote: they originally estimated revenues at $1.2 million but when they did all the calculations, there would be a deficit of about $200,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Proposed minimum charge increase to help balance the FY27 budget
budget_items.quote: they are suggesting a small increase on the minimum charge from $133 to $139.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Regular users proposed 16% rate increase projected to generate $26K surplus
budget_items.quote: the regular users would have a 16% increase - $15.85 to $18.38 - which would give a surplus of $26k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Proposed annual charge for single-family dwellings in new Stormwater Utility; businesses would pay higher rate
budget_items.quote: single family dwellings would be charged $100/year and businesses will have a higher rate.
